_corsComment: No Cors block here on purpose: in Development the CORS policy is not applied (see Program.cs). The Angular dev server proxies /api to this API (frontend/proxy.conf.json), so the browser sees everything on the same origin. Configuring origins here would have no effect. For production, see appsettings.Production.example.json.

Auth._comment: PermitLimit/WindowSeconds are per IP. Lockout* is per account, independent of IP.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Networks from which X-Forwarded-For is trusted. In dev the API is accessed directly (no proxy), so the header isn't used — loopback is on the list only to test the behavior locally.

_comment_otel: Sends logs to Grafana Cloud. Leave empty to skip exporting (console only). Get both values from grafana.com > your stack > OpenTelemetry tile > Configure. The endpoint is the base, without /v1/logs — LogConfig appends it. Keep 'Basic%20' escaped.
